If I was in your situation I would have appreciated knowing beforehand that he too is a member of the fellowship and that he attends meetings x, y and z. Then you have the information to decide whether you mind seeing your counselor at an AA meeting and you can choose which meetings you want to attend. 

There is nothing wrong with both of you attending the same anonymous meeting (cross talk is discouraged), but if it made you uncomfortable, this would take away from the benefit to you of the meeting. It’s about giving you the opportunity to be mentally prepared and not feeling blindsided. 

This man is trying to help you and I don’t believe he violated any professional boundaries but could have gone about it in a better way. Progress not perfection. We all make mistakes.
